ui.chat.credential_capture.paste_the_val: Paste the value again after /credential to store it again.
ui.chat.credential_capture.armed_add_a_s: armed — add a space, then type or paste the secret
ui.chat.credential_capture.masked_as_you: masked as you type — Enter makes a pill, Esc twice discards
ui.chat.credential_capture.masked_enter_: masked — Enter opens the credential picker; type or paste the secret into this span
ui.chat.credential_capture.esc_again_dis: Esc again discards it — still masked, Enter makes a pill
ui.chat.credential_capture.credential_di: credential discarded — nothing was stored or sent
ui.chat.credential_capture.masked_enter_: masked — Enter runs /credential, which needs an open conversation; type or paste the secret into this span
ui.chat.credential_capture.removed_recei: Removed {key} (credential #{index, number}) from this message. Its value is gone — press {undoCap} to put it back, or paste it again after /credential to reuse it.
ui.chat.credential_capture.held_label: Credential #{index, number}, {chars, number} chars — held in this message; its value cannot be read
ui.chat.credential_capture.stored_receip: Stored {keys}. Injected into every bash command as an environment variable; the agent cannot read the value.
ui.chat.credential_capture.unstored_rece: {count, plural, one {# credential could not be stored} other {# credentials could not be stored}} ({keys}); the agent has been told so. Paste the value again after /credential to retry.
ui.chat.credential_capture.unconfirmed_r: {count, plural, one {# credential could not be confirmed as stored} other {# credentials could not be confirmed as stored}} ({keys}); the agent has been told to check before using it. {operatorMove}
ui.chat.credential_capture.plain_text_wa: {length, number} characters are now PLAIN TEXT in the composer — Enter will expose them
